title: No trophy for a best time of 16:00
description: From the title screen, the player walks left into the scores door. The high scores panel shows a best time of 16:00, and the stand for the time's trophy is empty: the bronze trophy is only made below 960 seconds, though it's meant for 16:00 and under.
